name: dsfd_capt_status_x43_s_split1016y
structural_change: Successor of CLOSED dsfd_capt_status_x43_s_split1016x (TT +300.06 / FF +26.69, record 9da10a825), native FAIL capture rsv[0] 218.0 ps > 190 (native_audit_1316; launch 173.9, R 81.0, spread 6.5): rsv was the raw async reset of ~70 flops (sp/se/warm/mk/flt + 64-bit stq), so the recovery check ran through the reset buffer tree. RTL: rsv now drives only a 2-flop local stage rv0/rv1 (async assert, synchronous release, as dsfd_capt_x8x_s rv_s); rv1 resets sp/se/flt/stq with the values the rsv-direct leaf held after epoch edge 1 (sp 1, se 1; warm constant 1, removed), mk (t_mark pin register) unreset. t_st identical to the old leaf at every time for every rsv timing (tb_dsfd_capt_status_x43_eq): 0 added serial edges, startup contract unchanged. Same outline 21.6 x 86.4 and pin Tcl as split1016x. S leaf: input pin registers sh0/sh2/sh3/bq at every serial edge (zero added latency), fixed-edge 3:1 select into stq (64 flops), epoch parity + marker assertions (sticky, OR-ed into t_st[3]); inhold pads the coincident-edge b0 arc. Seam pins spread at 8 M4 tracks (gate oflop face density); f_sn / t_st moved to the centre of their bit's triplet.

reroute_reason.fix: RTL: rsv drives only a 2-flop local reset stage (rv0/rv1, async assert / sync release) instead of the async reset of ~70 flops; reset values compensated for the 2-edge stage delay (zero streaming-edge change, equivalence bench)
reroute_reason.why: native audit 1316: capture rsv[0] 218.0 ps > 190 on the CLOSED split1016x view (only failing pin)

job.purpose: dsfd_capt_status_x43_s native-capture successor: rsv -> 2-flop local reset stage, compensated reset values; exact capture split bench + unit/slip + equivalence vs the rsv-direct leaf + mutants, TT/FF/DRC0 + native audit
